description: The packing and shipping queue — the Shipping page. Each ship list is one warehouse's picked units for an order, waiting to be packed and shipped, with its status (created, inprogress = packing, readytoship, shipped), priority, shipper and quantities to ship, packed and shipped. Defaults to open lists (not yet shipped), oldest first. Call get_ship_list for a list's lines and packages.

clientId.description: Optional client id (GUID) for operator (unpinned) credentials on 3PL tenants.

search.description: Search text: ship list number, order number or customer.

status.description: open (default: not shipped), not_started, packing, ready_to_ship, shipped or all.

name: list_ship_lists
